settings.title: Settings
settings.description:
The settings allows you to specify time preferences.

            The possible settings and their allowed values are as follows:
                - `date_format`: The format for displaying dates.
                Allowed values are 'dd/mm/yyyy', 'mm/dd/yyyy', and 'yyy/mm/dd'.
                - `time_format`: The format for displaying time.
                Allowed values are '12h' and '24h'.
                - `country`: The country configuration. This is not validated.
                - `time_zone`: The time zone using dst aware Canonical timezones.
                    Format is their TZ identifier e.g. `Continent/City`.
                    See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

            If a `settings` value is set to `None`,
            the frontend should use the current system default values.

avatar_image_id.title: Avatar Image Id
avatar_image_id.description: The UUID of the image to set as the avatar image. Must be media that belongs to the user.
